### Compass Group

### Sun Life

### Boston College

“Our favorite feature would be the online request forms. Having the ability for our clients to be able to request space in real time was a game changer. We were able to streamline a rather tedious process.”

### George Washington University

“The sales lifecycle has been shortened by an average of 3-5 days with this new implementation. It’s just one more click and the software does the rest. My only regret is not implementing this change sooner!”
